ImageAcquisitionProtocol: Multiplexed sequential-round light-sheet imaging of one 200 um thick mouse brain slice. Deskewed, stitched and flat-field corrected 3D volume (full stitched field, not cropped, not registered across rounds). Channel 1 = marker; channel 2 = POPO-1 nuclear stain from the same acquisition, in the same voxel frame, for registration across rounds.
OtherAcquisitionParameters: channel 1: 561 nm excitation; channel 2: 405 nm excitation (POPO-1), imaged in the same acquisition as channel 1
SoftwareVersions: converted from stitched TIFF slices with tifffile 2026.5.15 + zarr 3.4.2 (OME-Zarr 0.4, 6-level 2x2x2 mean pyramid)
